test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following books was unveiled by the Union Minister Giriraj Singh in year 2022?

options.text: Pandemic disruptions and Odisha’s lessons in governance
Agenda for Members of Panchayati Raj Institutions for Rural Development

solution:
The correct answer is __**Agenda for Members of Panchayati Raj Institutions for Rural Development**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book titled **Agenda for Members of Panchayati Raj Institutions for Rural Development** was unveiled by Union Minister Giriraj Singh in the year 2022.
 
• The book serves as a comprehensive guide for the elected representatives of **Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs)** to effectively implement rural development programs and schemes.
 
• It covers various rural development aspects, including sanitation, water management, livelihood enhancement, and infrastructure development, **aimed at improving the quality of life in rural areas.**
 
• The book aims to build the capacity of PRI members by enhancing their understanding of different government schemes and how to implement them efficiently for rural development.
 
• The publication is an important step toward **empowering local self-governance** and ensuring the active participation of PRI members in achieving sustainable rural development goals across India. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Modi @20 Dreams meet delivery**

 
 
• The book presents an in-depth analysis of **Narendra Modi’s 20 years in public service,** exploring his leadership, governance model, and achievements both as the Chief Minister of Gujarat and the Prime Minister of India.
 
• It includes essays by prominent personalities like **Amit Shah, N. Chandrasekaran, and Sudha Murthy**, offering diverse perspectives on Modi's vision, policies, and their impact on national development.
 
• The book highlights key initiatives such as Digital India, Make in India, and Swachh Bharat, focusing on how Modi's leadership style transformed governance and aligned dreams with practical results.
 
 
 
• **Heartfelt: The Legacy of Faith**
 
 
• The book is written by** Prime Minister Narendra Modi,** reflecting on personal experiences and the importance of faith in navigating life’s challenges.
 
• It emphasizes the role of faith in shaping one’s life, highlighting spirituality, devotion, and the power of belief as key elements in personal growth and success.
 
• The book discusses how faith helps individuals find inner strength, remain grounded, and maintain focus in times of adversity, serving as a guiding force throughout life.
 
• Modi shares anecdotes and lessons from his own journey, illustrating the legacy of faith in shaping values and decisions,** both in personal and professional realms.**
